title: Dynamic node provisioning status (the `provisioning` member of POST /v1/node/heartbeat)
description: One entry per assignment a dynamic node has acted on (specs/64_DYNAMIC_NODES_AND_GATEWAY_PROVISIONING.md section 6). Read leniently by the gateway after the beat is accepted; a malformed entry is dropped, never a refused beat. The member is an array of these, a top-level member of the heartbeat body, sent on every beat while the capability is in force (`[]` when idle); the 65536-byte bound (on the compact serialization of the whole array) and the gateway's reading of at most 64 entries are rules the schema cannot express.

gpuIds.description: At most 64; a gateway keeps the first 64.

updatedAt.description: Unix seconds of the assignment's last change.

reason.description: Closed. Permanent (the pair is not tried again while the gateway runs): launch_failed, probe_failed, measure_failed. Transient (tried again after 600 s): artifact_unavailable, digest_mismatch, disk_full, runtime_unavailable, engine_exited. refused is never a verdict on a profile; the gateway backs the placement off.

message.description: What failed, at most 512 characters (a node cuts a longer one); never the bytes that failed it.

evidence.description: One measured cell, as a runtime profile's evidence row: decodeTps is the aggregate decode rate across the cell's concurrent streams at the named context depth (specs/39, invariant 42).
